tokens.name: hrs-ground
tokens.usage: Page ground under the Play scene, and what shows if the scene is off. Never a panel fill.

tokens.name: hrs-tint
tokens.usage: Base colour of every panel film: composed with hrs-surface-alpha over the scene (oklch(from) syntax). Panels, side nav, table rows.

tokens.name: hrs-tint-raised
tokens.usage: Film base for raised surfaces: popovers, menus, select panels, drawers, tooltips, the top bar. Composed with hrs-surface-alpha-raised.

tokens.name: hrs-selection
tokens.usage: Selected row / active list item fill, hovered row at hrs-hover-alpha. Always under hrs-text.

tokens.name: hrs-border
tokens.usage: The 1px line on every panel, button, field, card and divider. 3:1 against hrs-tint in every theme.

tokens.name: hrs-border-strong
tokens.usage: Border of hovered, focused and selected things; the sub-bar active underline; sort arrow.

tokens.name: hrs-accent
tokens.usage: Accent text and icons: active nav label glow, links, chevron on section headings, primary button text. 4.5:1 on hrs-tint and hrs-tint-raised.

tokens.name: hrs-glow
tokens.usage: Colour of every outer glow (box-shadow, drop-shadow) on hover/selected/primary and StyledText. 66% lightness in every theme with the chroma sRGB holds at that hue (cyan lifted to 72%), so no theme glows louder. Never a fill or text.

tokens.name: hrs-text
tokens.usage: Titles, names, values, button labels. On hrs-tint, hrs-tint-raised, hrs-selection and hrs-ground in every theme.

tokens.name: hrs-text-muted
tokens.usage: Body copy, labels, column headers, placeholders, secondary values. On hrs-tint and hrs-tint-raised; 4.5:1 in every theme.

tokens.name: hrs-text-dim
tokens.usage: Disabled text and empty-slot labels only (decorative, 3:1 on hrs-tint). Never for content that must be read.

tokens.name: hrs-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a solid hrs-accent fill (filled checkbox, slider thumb, count badge). Dark, never white.

tokens.name: hrs-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring (2px solid, 2px offset) on every surface in every theme; the game has none, this is the web's.

tokens.name: hrs-team-blue
tokens.usage: Ally / team-1 player names and markers (lifted from game LabelYourTeam #3184ff for 4.5:1 on hrs-selection). Text on hrs-tint. Pair with theme="blue" for whole panels.

tokens.name: hrs-team-red
tokens.usage: Enemy / team-2 player names and markers (lifted from game LabelEnemyTeam #f70b21 for 4.5:1 on hrs-tint). Panels: theme="red".

tokens.name: hrs-self
tokens.usage: The user's own player wherever they appear in a list (the game's self green, hue 137: the profile frame's _self, the score screen's self overlay). Panels about the user: theme="self".

tokens.name: hrs-gold
tokens.usage: Ownership and heroic marks: OWNED lines, heroic key outlines, the active section heading, the portrait frame fallback.

tokens.name: hrs-error
tokens.usage: Error lines and failed imports (the chat's red). Text on hrs-tint; always with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: hrs-info
tokens.usage: System and informational lines (the chat's blue): 'has come online', import finished.

tokens.name: hrs-warning
tokens.usage: Warnings and partial states. Text on hrs-tint.

styles.name: nav-1
styles.usage: Level-1 nav labels: the game's TaskBarNavigation style (Metronic Bold, height 30, Uppercase, gradient text 9d90ff→8f99fb with a dark glow; selected cbe8ff→ffffff with glow 0063c8). Here: gradient from the theme accent, selected from hrs-text with the theme glow.

styles.name: nav-2
styles.usage: Level-2 sub-bar tabs: the game's TaskBarSubNavigation style (height 18, no uppercase, gradient 9d90ff→aab2ff; selected cbe8ff→ffffff, glow 0063c8), title case as the game writes them.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, column headers, card status lines, uppercase.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Panel titles, hero and player names in headers.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section headings inside content, with the chevron.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names and values beside a label, in hrs-text.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Table cells, list rows, chat lines, helper text.

tokens.name: hrs-space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: badge inset, divider margins.

tokens.name: hrs-space-2
tokens.usage: Inside buttons and fields vertically; gap between icon and label.

tokens.name: hrs-space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; table cell padding; list row padding.

tokens.name: hrs-space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between controls.

tokens.name: hrs-space-5
tokens.usage: Section gaps inside a panel.

tokens.name: hrs-space-6
tokens.usage: Page padding on desktop; gap between panels.

tokens.name: hrs-space-8
tokens.usage: Modal padding; gap between page sections.

tokens.name: hrs-space-12
tokens.usage: Hero header spacing.

tokens.name: hrs-bar-1
tokens.usage: Top bar height (level 1): the game's TopNavContainer is 108 units, the sub bar 52; 64/36 keeps that ratio at web size.

tokens.name: hrs-bar-2
tokens.usage: Sub-bar height (level 2); see hrs-bar-1.

tokens.name: hrs-side-nav
tokens.usage: Level-3 side list width on desktop.

tokens.name: hrs-side-panel
tokens.usage: Right tool drawer width.

tokens.name: hrs-control
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, fields and selects; icon buttons are square at this size.

tokens.name: hrs-control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, chips, toggle-group items, sub-bar tabs.

tokens.name: hrs-radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything: panels, buttons, fields, cards, modals. The system is square.

tokens.name: hrs-radius-1
tokens.usage: Only badges, chips and the slider thumb, so they don't look like tiny panels.

tokens.name: hrs-glow-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered button, card, row and nav item.

tokens.name: hrs-glow-selected
tokens.usage: Selected list item, active toggle, focused field, primary button at rest.

tokens.name: hrs-glow-panel
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus and the modal panel: the panel 'lifts' with a wide faint glow.

tokens.name: hrs-glow-modal
tokens.usage: The modal dialog's halo over the blurred page.

tokens.name: hrs-shade
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces also drop a plain shadow under the glow so they read over bright art.

opacity.note: The film over the Play scene. These are the floors: the Opacity setting (Settings → Theme) raises all of them together towards solid, never below.

tokens.name: hrs-surface-alpha
tokens.usage: Panels, side nav, cards, table rows over the scene: oklch(from var(--hrs-tint) l c h / var(--hrs-surface-alpha)).

tokens.name: hrs-surface-alpha-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, selects, drawers, tooltips, the top bar: nearly solid so text stays legible over anything.

tokens.name: hrs-surface-alpha-modal
tokens.usage: The modal dialog panel.

tokens.name: hrs-scrim-alpha
tokens.usage: The page scrim under a modal, drawn in hrs-ground.

tokens.name: hrs-hover-alpha
tokens.usage: Hovered rows and list items: hrs-selection at this alpha.

effect.note: Backdrop blur is a setting, off by default (CPU cost over the animated scene). When on, these are the values.

tokens.name: hrs-backdrop
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter of panels and the side nav. Setting on: blur(6px).

tokens.name: hrs-backdrop-raised
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter of popovers, menus, drawers and the top bar. Setting on: blur(10px).

tokens.name: hrs-backdrop-modal
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter of the modal scrim. Setting on: blur(12px) saturate(0.8).

tokens.name: hrs-pattern-alpha
tokens.usage: Strength of the low-poly mesh (an SVG wireframe mask in the theme's accent): the modal scrim at this value; the TopBar mesh at 1.2× with the rolling band at 4×. A stand-in until the game's own mesh and flash textures are extracted (README › Game assets).

tokens.name: hrs-nav-shimmer
tokens.usage: One pass of the TopBar shimmer through the triangle mask (the game's BackgroundTriangleShimmer animation: an 8 s loop, UV scroll with a 0→255→0 fade envelope). Off under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: hrs-nav-pulse
tokens.usage: The selected nav button's glow pulse (the game's GlowImage Toggled animation: fade 0→255 over 2 s, back over 2 s, looping).

tokens.name: hrs-nav-sparkle
tokens.usage: One rise of a selected-button sparkle triangle (the game's ShapesContainer SparkleAnim: rise over 1.8 s, fade in at 0.5 s and out at 1.6 s, a 3 s spin).
